alternatives.name: Opening cinematic
alternatives.what: zone 7 act 0 run by the ordinary level engine: Sonic runs right, a flying machine (type $1F) dives in, hovers ahead of him and leaves; Tails follows; 738 updates (871 harness frames from power-on to the title flag)

alternatives.what: Sonic and Tails logo, SONIC CHAOS, (c) 1993 SEGA, blinking PRESS START BUTTON, sound requests $BE/$BF/$99; 1,310 harness frames; owned by earlier title work (PRES-FOLLOWUP-1 / G5)

alternatives.name: Attract demo
alternatives.what: three rotating recorded runs THZ1 (Sonic), GPZ1 (Tails), SEZ1 (Sonic); recorded input pointers in the ROM (region-dependent table D12D); 1,080 updates each (1,230 harness frames)

alternatives.name: Act title card
alternatives.what: zone name and act number cards between results and gameplay - NOT an opening

alternatives.evidence: OBSERVED: harness frames 1-80 are black, no logo tiles or text are loaded before the scene
alternatives.name: Sega logo / licence screen

evidence: EMULATED ORIGINAL FRAME (power-on, no input; harness NTSC timing, +/-1 frame; real Europe hardware is 50 Hz, the game's own timing is in updates)

no_sega_logo.reading: CRAM stays all-zero until the scene fade-in; the first colours appear at harness frame 91. No logo, text or tile stream precedes the cinematic; the POC's OBJ_menu_opening / SPR_opening_sega is inherited openSonicSMS art, not a ROM resource

skip_test.reading: bit 7 (START requested) is set by $063C from button 1/2; $0796 leaves the opening loop at once; the handler then fades to black ($1CAF), waits 30 frames and enters the TITLE (D292 bit 4); it does NOT start a game
